system.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Suppress Injury (EC15)

ACTION • Burn 2 • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: Touch; self or adjacent / One living willing creature

Effect: Choose up to two Wound Conditions on the target. Suppress their penalties until the end of the current Encounter, or for 1 minute if used outside an Encounter. Their Core Wounds remain marked and still determine Wound State. This does not restore Temporary Wounds, repair bodily loss, stabilize a Critical Wound, or stop any rule for dying.

Design note: Never suppresses the existence of a Wound or makes the target count as less injured. Not healing.
system.flavor: Temporarily functioning through injuries without removing them.
